verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review service that processes customer code, so a training opt-out or no-training guarantee is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documentation of a training opt-out, a data-retention policy, or any statement about whether customer code trains models. The memory-and-learning feature, which extracts learnings from reviewer comments, is a review-personalization feature, not a training-privacy control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
